systems.purpose: Carry engine and turbo heat to the radiator; provide cabin heating and coolant recovery.
Lubricate engine and turbo bearings, reject oil heat and meter oil for rotor sealing.
Deliver fuel to the staged injection assembly and return excess fuel to the tank.
Transmit pedal-generated hydraulic pressure to four wheel brakes.
Transmit clutch-pedal motion to the release cylinder.
Provide hydraulic steering assistance and return fluid through the cooling loop.
